next.reason: 1985: "may be specified only in file description entries ... or in record description entries in the Working-Storage Section"; 2023: "only in file description entries, in level 1 data description entries in the working-storage section, and in level 1 type declarations". Same file description and working-storage placements, but 2023 adds level 1 type declarations as a permitted place for EXTERNAL, which 1985 does not allow.
